prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production albedo texture for the ground of a realistic hand-painted 2.5D medieval strategy world map. Primary request: a high-quality natural meadow grass surface without visible repetitions or joins. Square, orthographic straight top-down flat ground, edge to edge, no horizon. Dense fine interwoven short grass blades in muted olive, sage, moss and straw tones, a little subdued dark earth visible between individual blades. Organic irregular distribution at the tiny blade scale. Uniform overall density and even diffuse overcast illumination; low-contrast, consistent average color across the entire square, gently textured not blurry. Small dry wisps and tiny leaves integrated naturally. Refined naturalistic painted game texture, high spatial detail with restrained contrast. Avoid large clumps, distinct circular tufts, swirls, spirals, diagonal channels, paths, bare soil islands, dramatic patches, stripes, repeating ornaments, checkerboard, seams, tile montage, rocks, trees, flowers, shadows, vignette, perspective, text, labels, borders. One coherent original grass texture.
